name: paramNeuronOut
doc:
第 \`i\` 个约束对应的神经元输出，其**权重槽由参数 \`p i\` 供给**
（而**不是**由约束系数 \`(cs i).a\` 烤死）。\`p i\` 是 \`Fin n → ℝ\` 的投影。
stmt:
noncomputable def paramNeuronOut {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (i : Fin n) : ℝ
proof: p i * x + (cs i).b

name: paramLoss
doc:
⭐⭐ **参数化总损失** \`paramLoss cs x p = Σᵢ (pᵢ·x + bᵢ)²\`。
\`p\` 是自由的**可训练参数向量**（对照 \`RealTotalLoss (compileFin cs) x\`：那里 \`pᵢ\` 被替换为烤死的 \`(cs i).a\`）。
stmt:
noncomputable def paramLoss {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint)
    (x : ℝ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i : Fin n, (paramNeuronOut cs p x i) ^ 2

name: symParam
doc: 符号参数向量：把约束系数 \`(cs i).a\` 作为参数注入（即 \`compileFin\` 的 ℝ 侧对偶）。
stmt: noncomputable def symParam {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint) : Fin n → ℝ
proof: fun i => (cs i).a

name: paramLoss_zero_iff_all_outputs
doc: 零损失 ⟺ 每个参数化神经元输出为零（\`p\` **全称**，无任何对 \`p\` 的限制）。
stmt:
theorem paramLoss_zero_iff_all_outputs {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint)
    (x : ℝ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) :
    paramLoss cs x p = 0 ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, paramNeuronOut cs p x i = 0
proof:
by
  unfold paramLoss
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg]
  · constructor
    · intro h i
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (h i (Finset.mem_univ i))
    · intro h i _
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mpr (h i)
  · intro i _
    exact sq_nonneg (paramNeuronOut cs p x i)

name: paramLoss_zero_iff_pConstraint
doc:
⭐⭐ **MPO-1（自由参数版）**：对**任意**参数 \`p\`，零损失 ⟺ **p-参数化**约束成立。
即损失面是参数空间上一个良定义的「满足性指示」。
stmt:
theorem paramLoss_zero_iff_pConstraint {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint)
    (x : ℝ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) :
    paramLoss cs x p = 0 ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, p i * x + (cs i).b = 0
proof:
by
  rw [show paramLoss cs x p = ∑ i : Fin n, (p i * x + (cs i).b) ^ 2 from rfl]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg]
  · constructor
    · intro h i
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (h i (Finset.mem_univ i))
    · intro h i _
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mpr (h i)
  · intro i _
    exact sq_nonneg _

name: paramLoss_symParam_zero_iff
doc:
⭐⭐⭐ **MPO-1（符号参数版，主定理）**：在符号参数 \`symParam cs\` 处，
**零损失 ⟺ 符号约束全部满足**。这是「训练把损失压到 0 ⟹ 符号约束被满足」的类型载体。
stmt:
theorem paramLoss_symParam_zero_iff {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) :
    paramLoss cs x (symParam cs) = 0 ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, (cs i).a * x + (cs i).b = 0
proof:
by
  rw [show paramLoss cs x (symParam cs)
        = ∑ i : Fin n, ((cs i).a * x + (cs i).b) ^ 2 from rfl]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg]
  · constructor
    · intro h i
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (h i (Finset.mem_univ i))
    · intro h i _
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mpr (h i)
  · intro i _
    exact sq_nonneg _

name: paramLoss_pos_of_unsatisfied
doc: 不满足 ⟹ 损失**严格为正**（训练可观测的失败信号）。
stmt:
theorem paramLoss_pos_of_unsatisfied {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint)
    (x : ℝ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (h : p i * x + (cs i).b ≠ 0) :
    0 < paramLoss cs x p
proof:
by
  unfold paramLoss
  have hsq : 0 < (paramNeuronOut cs p x i) ^ 2 := by
    have hne : paramNeuronOut cs p x i ≠ 0 := by
      unfold paramNeuronOut; exact h
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (by
      intro hs; exact hne (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hs)))
  have hle : (paramNeuronOut cs p x i) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, (paramNeuronOut cs p x j) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (paramNeuronOut cs p x j) ^ 2)
      (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hsq hle

name: paramLoss_forall_p_false
doc:
⭐⭐ **消融见证**：S01 原陈述（\`p\` 全称版）**为假**。
反例 \`cs = ⟨1,0⟩\`、\`x = 5\`、\`p = 0\`：损失 \`0\` 但约束 \`5 ≠ 0\`。
⟹ 「零损失 ⟺ 约束满足」**不能**对任意 \`p\` 声称；\`symParam\` 这个限制**删不掉**。
stmt:
theorem paramLoss_forall_p_false :
    ¬ (∀ (n : Nat) (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) (p : Fin n → ℝ),
        paramLoss cs x p = 0 ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, (cs i).a * x + (cs i).b = 0)
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hh := h 1 (fun _ => (⟨1, 0⟩ : RealConstraint)) 5 (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
  have hloss : paramLoss (n := 1) (fun _ => (⟨1, 0⟩ : RealConstraint)) 5
      (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    simp [paramLoss, paramNeuronOut]
  have hsat := hh.mp hloss
  have h0 := hsat 0
  norm_num at h0

name: paramLoss_not_const
doc:
⭐ **消融见证（非平凡性）**：损失对参数**不是常函数** ⟹ 损失面有内容，
\`∇_p paramLoss\` 非恒零（MPO-2 梯度下降回路的前提）。
stmt:
theorem paramLoss_not_const :
    ∃ (cs : Fin 1 → RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) (p q : Fin 1 → ℝ),
      paramLoss cs x p ≠ paramLoss cs x q
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun _ => (⟨0, 1⟩ : RealConstraint), 1, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 1, ?_⟩
  simp only [paramLoss, paramNeuronOut, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  norm_num

name: layerParam
doc: 从链核心 \`LinearLayer\` 的 ℤ 权重经跨宇宙桥 \`symW\` 提取参数向量。
stmt: noncomputable def layerParam (n : Nat) (l : LinearLayer) : Fin n → ℝ
proof: symW n l.w

name: paramLoss_one_eq_layerOut_sq
doc:
⭐⭐ **接线定理**：参数化损失在「层权重」这一参数点上，等于该层 \`RealDot\` 输出的平方。
⟹ 本库**第一条**把\`参数化损失\`与链核心 \`LinearLayer\` 接在同一等式上的边
（\`symW\` 来自 \`RealCrossUniverseBridge.lean\`）。
stmt:
theorem paramLoss_one_eq_layerOut_sq (n : Nat) (l : LinearLayer) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    paramLoss (n := 1) (fun _ => (⟨0, 0⟩ : RealConstraint))
        (RealDot (layerParam n l) x) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
      = (RealDot (layerParam n l) x) ^ 2
proof:
by
  simp only [paramLoss, Fin.sum_univ_one, paramNeuronOut]
  ring

end Lattice

name: train_verify_protocol
stmt:
theorem train_verify_protocol (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x₀ : E) (c ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hspec : ∀ x : E, ‖(1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, ∀ {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
      (μ { x : α | ε ≤ ‖A (GDIterate A b η t x₀) - b‖ ^ 2 }).toReal ≤ ε
proof:
by
                                    
  rcases (GD_converges A b η x₀ c hc0 hc1 hspec (ε ^ 2) (by positivity : 0 < ε ^ 2))
    with ⟨t, ht⟩
                                                                 
  have ht' : ‖A (GDIterate A b η t x₀) - b‖ ^ 2 < ε ^ 2 := by
    simpa [GDError] using ht
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  intro α hms μ hprob
  haveI := hprob
                                       
  have hfn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun _ : α => ‖A (GDIterate A b η t x₀) - b‖ ^ 2 :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hfi : Integrable (fun _ : α => ‖A (GDIterate A b η t x₀) - b‖ ^ 2) μ := integrable_const _
  have hE : (∫ x : α, ‖A (GDIterate A b η t x₀) - b‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ ε ^ 2 := by
                                  
    rw [integral_const]
    simp [measure_univ]
    linarith [ht']
                      
  exact verify_probability_guarantee hfn hfi hε hE

             
                                         
                                                  
                                 
                                  
                                          

end Lattice

name: WeightedLoss2
stmt: def WeightedLoss2 (A₁ A₂ : E →L[𝕜] F) (b₁ b₂ : F) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ) (x : E) : ℝ
proof: w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ x + w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ x

name: weighted2_fderiv
stmt:
theorem weighted2_fderiv (A₁ A₂ : E →L[𝕜] F) (b₁ b₂ : F) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (WeightedLoss2 A₁ A₂ b₁ b₂ w₁ w₂) x v
      = 2 * w₁ * RCLike.re ⟪A₁ x - b₁, A₁ v⟫ + 2 * w₂ * RCLike.re ⟪A₂ x - b₂, A₂ v⟫
proof:
by
  unfold WeightedLoss2
  have hd₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ y) x :=
    (loss_differentiable_scalar A₁ b₁ x).const_mul w₁
  have hd₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ y) x :=
    (loss_differentiable_scalar A₂ b₂ x).const_mul w₂
  have hlin : fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ y + w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ y) x
      = fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ y) x + fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ y) x :=
    fderiv_add hd₁ hd₂
  have hc₁ : fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ y) x v
      = w₁ * fderiv ℝ (NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁) x v := by
    rw [fderiv_const_mul (loss_differentiable_scalar A₁ b₁ x) w₁]
    simp
  have hc₂ : fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ y) x v
      = w₂ * fderiv ℝ (NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂) x v := by
    rw [fderiv_const_mul (loss_differentiable_scalar A₂ b₂ x) w₂]
    simp
  calc
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ y + w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ y) x v
        = (fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ y) x
            + fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ y) x) v := by
          rw [hlin]
    _ = fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₁ * NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁ y) x v
        + fderiv ℝ (fun y => w₂ * NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂ y) x v := by simp
    _ = w₁ * fderiv ℝ (NormSqLossScalar A₁ b₁) x v + w₂ * fderiv ℝ (NormSqLossScalar A₂ b₂) x v := by
          rw [hc₁, hc₂]
    _ = w₁ * (2 * RCLike.re ⟪A₁ x - b₁, A₁ v⟫) + w₂ * (2

name: weighted2_stationarity_iff
stmt:
theorem weighted2_stationarity_iff (A₁ A₂ : E →L[𝕜] F) (b₁ b₂ : F) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (WeightedLoss2 A₁ A₂ b₁ b₂ w₁ w₂) x = 0 ↔
      ∀ v : E, w₁ * RCLike.re ⟪A₁ x - b₁, A₁ v⟫ + w₂ * RCLike.re ⟪A₂ x - b₂, A₂ v⟫ = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hfd v
    have hlin : fderiv ℝ (WeightedLoss2 A₁ A₂ b₁ b₂ w₁ w₂) x v = 0 := by
      rw [hfd]
      simp
    rw [weighted2_fderiv A₁ A₂ b₁ b₂ w₁ w₂ x v] at hlin
    nlinarith
  · intro h
    ext v
    rw [weighted2_fderiv A₁ A₂ b₁ b₂ w₁ w₂ x v]
    have hzero : w₁ * RCLike.re ⟪A₁ x - b₁, A₁ v⟫ + w₂ * RCLike.re ⟪A₂ x - b₂, A₂ v⟫ = 0 := h v
    calc
      2 * w₁ * RCLike.re ⟪A₁ x - b₁, A₁ v⟫ + 2 * w₂ * RCLike.re ⟪A₂ x - b₂, A₂ v⟫
          = 2 * (w₁ * RCLike.re ⟪A₁ x - b₁, A₁ v⟫ + w₂ * RCLike.re ⟪A₂ x - b₂, A₂ v⟫) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by
            rw [hzero]
            ring

name: weighted2_stationarity_of_components
stmt:
theorem weighted2_stationarity_of_components (A₁ A₂ : E →L[𝕜] F) (b₁ b₂ : F)
    (w₁ w₂ : ℝ) (x : E)
    (h₁ : ∀ v : E, RCLike.re ⟪A₁ x - b₁, A₁ v⟫ = 0)
    (h₂ : ∀ v : E, RCLike.re ⟪A₂ x - b₂, A₂ v⟫ = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (WeightedLoss2 A₁ A₂ b₁ b₂ w₁ w₂) x = 0
proof:
by
  ext v
  rw [weighted2_fderiv A₁ A₂ b₁ b₂ w₁ w₂ x v, h₁ v, h₂ v]
  simp

                
                                               
                                
                                        
                                      

end Lattice

name: WeightedLossN
stmt: def WeightedLossN {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → E →L[𝕜] F) (b : Fin n → F) (w : Fin n → ℝ) (x : E) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i : Fin n, w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) x

name: weightedN_fderiv
stmt:
theorem weightedN_fderiv {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → E →L[𝕜] F) (b : Fin n → F) (w : Fin n → ℝ) (x v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (WeightedLossN A b w) x v
      = ∑ i : Fin n, 2 * w i * RCLike.re ⟪A i x - b i, A i v⟫
proof:
by
  unfold WeightedLossN
                       
  have hdiff : ∀ i : Fin n,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x := by
    intro i
    exact (loss_differentiable_scalar (A i) (b i) x).const_mul (w i)
                                    
  have hlin : fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin n, w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x
      = ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x := by
    exact fderiv_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun i y => w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y)
      (fun i hi => hdiff i)
                                            
  have hitem : ∀ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x v
      = 2 * w i * RCLike.re ⟪A i x - b i, A i v⟫ := by
    intro i
    calc
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x v
          = w i * fderiv ℝ (NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i)) x v := by
            rw [fderiv_const_mul (loss_differentiable_scalar (A i) (b i) x) (w i)]
            simp
      _ = w i * (2 * RCLike.re ⟪A i x - b i, A i v⟫) := by
            rw [fderiv_loss_apply_scalar (A i) (b i) x v]
      _ = 2 * w i * RCLike.re ⟪A i x - b i, A i v⟫ := by ring
  calc
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin n, w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x v
        = (∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x) v := by
          rw [hlin]
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w i * NormSqLossScalar (A i) (b i) y) x v := by
          simp

name: weightedN_stationarity_of_components
stmt:
theorem weightedN_stationarity_of_components {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → E →L[𝕜] F)
    (b : Fin n → F) (w : Fin n → ℝ) (x : E)
    (h : ∀ (i : Fin n) (v : E), RCLike.re ⟪A i x - b i, A i v⟫ = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (WeightedLossN A b w) x = 0
proof:
by
  ext v
  rw [weightedN_fderiv A b w x v]
                 
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  simp [h i v]

             
                                                   
                                            
                                 
                                     

end Lattice

name: repairEven
stmt: noncomputable def repairEven (x : Nat) : Nat
proof: if EvenSat x then x else x - 1

name: iterateRepairEven
stmt:
noncomputable def iterateRepairEven : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, x => x
  | n + 1, x => repairEven (iterateRepairEven n x)

name: odd_gt_zero
stmt: lemma odd_gt_zero (x : Nat) (h : x % 2 = 1) : 1 ≤ x
proof:
by
  by_contra hlt
  have hx : x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hlt
  simp [hx] at h

name: repairEven_odd_to_even
stmt: lemma repairEven_odd_to_even (x : Nat) (h : x % 2 = 1) : EvenSat (x - 1)
proof:
by
  unfold EvenSat
                                     
  have hdiv : x = x / 2 * 2 + x % 2 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.div_add_mod x 2).symm
  rw [h] at hdiv
  have hx : x = x / 2 * 2 + 1 := hdiv
             
  have hsub : x - 1 = x / 2 * 2 := by omega
  rw [hsub]
                  
  exact Nat.mul_mod_left (x / 2) 2

name: repairEven_preserves
stmt: lemma repairEven_preserves (x : Nat) (h : EvenSat x) : EvenSat (repairEven x)
proof:
by
  unfold repairEven
  simp [h]

name: even_loop_converges
stmt: theorem even_loop_converges (x : Nat) : ∃ n : Nat, EvenSat (iterateRepairEven n x)
proof:
by
                               
  have hmod : x % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt x (by decide)
  have hcases : x % 2 = 0 ∨ x % 2 = 1 := by
    omega
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1
  ·                     
    exact ⟨0, by simp [iterateRepairEven, EvenSat, h0]⟩
  ·                      
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp [iterateRepairEven, repairEven, EvenSat, h1]
    exact repairEven_odd_to_even x h1

name: iterateRepairEven_add
stmt:
lemma iterateRepairEven_add (n m x : Nat) :
    iterateRepairEven (n + m) x = iterateRepairEven m (iterateRepairEven n x)
proof:
by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [iterateRepairEven]
  | succ m ih =>
      calc
        iterateRepairEven (n + (m + 1)) x = iterateRepairEven ((n + m) + 1) x := by
          rw [Nat.add_assoc]
        _ = repairEven (iterateRepairEven (n + m) x) := by simp [iterateRepairEven]
        _ = repairEven (iterateRepairEven m (iterateRepairEven n x)) := by rw [ih]
        _ = iterateRepairEven (m + 1) (iterateRepairEven n x) := by simp [iterateRepairEven]

name: even_loop_stays
stmt:
theorem even_loop_stays (x : Nat) (n : Nat) (h : EvenSat x) :
    EvenSat (iterateRepairEven n x)
proof:
by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simpa [iterateRepairEven] using h
  | succ n ih => simpa [iterateRepairEven] using repairEven_preserves (iterateRepairEven n x) (ih x h)

name: even_loop_fixpoint
stmt:
theorem even_loop_fixpoint (x : Nat) :
    ∃ n : Nat, EvenSat (iterateRepairEven n x) ∧
      ∀ m : Nat, EvenSat (iterateRepairEven (n + m) x)
proof:
by
  rcases even_loop_converges x with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact ⟨n, hn, fun m => by
    rw [iterateRepairEven_add n m x]
    exact even_loop_stays (iterateRepairEven n x) m hn⟩

end Lattice
